tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying thig las/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor phyag rgya gcig pa bzhugs//

na mo gu ru ār+ya tā ra ye/ 'dir 'chi med 'phags ma'i snying thig gi rtsa ba'i sgrub pa 'phrin las ye shes snang ba'i don gyi snying po'i bcud phyung ba rgyun gyi rnal 'byor phyag rgya gcig pa nyams su blang ba'i tshul la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ 'di nyid kyi smin byed legs par thob cing dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa/ byang chub sems gnyis kyi blo 'byong shing brtson 'grus yal bar mi 'dor bas/ gnas dben par bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i spyan sngar rang gzhan yid can thams cad sgo gsum 'jug pa gcig pas skyabs su gsol zhing sems bskyed par mos pas/ na mo: bdag sogs 'gro kun byang chub bar: dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo nyid: bla ma yid bzhin 'khor lo la: mi phyed gus pas skyabs su mchi: lan gsum/ ho: mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus kun: sdug bsngal mtsho las bsgral bya'i phyir: rje btsun 'phags ma'i rnal 'byor gyis: 'chi med bsgrub par sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes rdo rje'i sngags kyi rang sgras gdug pa can thams cad ring du bskrad/ badz+ra dz+nyā na rak+ṣa āḥhūm̐ gis srung ba'i 'khor lo brtan par bsgom/ dngos su bshams pa'i mchod pa yod na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pū dza me gha sa ma ye hūm̐: zhes dang nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas brlab bo// gnyis pa la gnyis/ mnyam bzhag gi nyams len gyi gtso bo lha bsgom pa dang*/ de'i yan lag tu bzlas brjod kyi bsam gtan la 'jug pa'o// dang po la gsum/ dam tshig pa gsal gdab pa/ ye shes pa spyan drangs shing bstim pa/ lha sku'i gsal snang la sems gzung ba'o// dang po ni/ rgyu ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis khog phub cing*/ 'bras bu rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed tshul dmigs 'don zung du chud pas/

oṃ mahā shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bha wa at+ma ko3 ham̐: 'khor 'das chos kun gzod ma nas: 'od gsal de bzhin nyid dbyings las: zung 'jug kun snang snying rje'i rtsal: rgyu yi ting 'dzin traṃ dkar po: mkha' las 'ja' tshon bzhin du shar: 'od 'phros snod bcud dngos 'dzin sbyangs: 'byung lnga yum gyi mkha' klong du: nor bu chu shel las grub pa'i: thar pa chen po'i gzhal med khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid rdzogs: de dbus pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i steng : thabs shes nyi zla kha sbyor dbus: zung 'jug tām̐ yig snyoms par zhugs: de las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod: 'khor 'das dwangs bcud gcig tu 'dus: yongs gyur ye shes sgyu ma'i sku: dus gsum rgyal ba'i phrin las bdag: 'chi med yid bzhin 'khor lo ni: rab dkar zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma: phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pa ni: dkon mchog gsum mtshon skyabs sbyin rgyas: ut+pa lar gnas tshe bum bsnams: zhi 'dzum ye shes spyan bdun ldan: dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes: zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung gis: pad+ma zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs: rang 'od thabs mchog gar gyi dbang : pad+ma tshe bum bsnams pas 'khril: gnyis pa ni/ de yi spyi mgrin thugs ka ru: rdo rje gsum gyi yi ges mtshan: de las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis: ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs gyur: ces gsal btab la/ hrīḥ so sor kun tu rtog pa yi: ye shes chen po tshe yi lha: 'od dpag med pa'i dbu rgyan can: dus gsum sangs rgyas phrin las ma: tshur gshegs yid bzhin 'khor lo 'chang: sgrub la dngos grub mchog stsol phyir: dam tshig dkyil 'khor 'dir dgongs la: rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed du gsol: sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: e ā ral+li hrīṃ hrīṃ dzaḥ dz+nyā na sa twa a ā: zhes pas spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa badz+ra dz+nyā na dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: ces da gug gzhug bcing mnyes dgyes pa bskyed cing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/

zhar byung phyag mchod bstod pa mdor bsdus byed par spro na/ a la la hoḥ a ti pu hoḥ pra tits+tsha ho: sa phyag bya/ oṃ: dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas kun: 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lor 'bul: bzhes nas 'chi med dngos grub stsol: oṃ ār+yā tā ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhu pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai bi d+ya shap+da ru pa shap+ta gan+dhe ra sa par+ṣe pra tīts+tsha swāhā: sarba pañca a mri ta mahā rak+ta mahā ba liṃ ta khā hi: sarba dharmā dhā tu āt+ma ko3haṃ: zhes phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyis mchod/ oṃ: 'jig rten dbang phyug snying rje'i bdag: zhal gyi chu skyes las byung ba: dus gsum sangs rgyas skyed mdzad yum: yid bzhin 'khor lor phyag 'tshal bstod: ces bstod/ gsum pa ni dam tshig ye shes dbyer med pa'i lha sku phyag rgya chen po spyi dang bye phrag gi gsal snang la rtse gcig tu sems bzung : nga rgyal brtan por bskyed/ gsal brtan gyi nyams skyes pa na gzhi 'bras sbrel ba'i dag pa dran pas bskyed rim mchog gi dngos grub kyi nyer rgyur smin pa la bslab par bya'o: gnyis pa ni/ de lta bu'i sgom pas dub na/ bogs 'byin pa'i slad du bzlas brjod kyi bsam gtan la bslab pa ni: rang nyid 'phags ma'i thugs ka ru: ye shes sems dpa' tshe dpag med: dkar gsal mnyam gzhag tshe bum 'dzin: dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes: rdo rje'i skyil krung pad zlar bzhugs: 'od dang 'od zer 'phro ba yi: thugs dbus chu skyes nyi zla'i dbus: tām̐ mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor: bzlas pas thugs dam rgyud bskul te: 'od kyi snang ba mtha' yas pa: gtsug tor nor bu'i rtse nas 'thon: de las 'phags ma rnam par rgyal: chu shel mdog can phyag g.yas kyi: skyabs sbyin phyag rgyas lcags kyu dang: g.yon pas mchog sbyin tshe bum bsnams: 'od dang 'od zer dang bcas pa:

grangs med nyi zer rdul ltar 'phros: 'khor 'das brtan g.yo'i dwangs bcud kun: bde ba chen po'i rnam par bsdus: bdag gi sgo gsum thig ler thim: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub dang : bde chen ye shes rgyas par gyur: ces brjod cing bsam la dran pa mngon du bzhag ste/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swāhā: ces rdo rje'i yi ge bcu pa gtso bor bzla zhing : thun mthar bsnyen sgrub las gsum chig dril gyi sngags: oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re hrī bh+ruṃ badz+ra dz+nyā na ā yu ṣe swāhā: zhes pa'ang ci rigs pa dang*/ spro zhing nus na/ oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzi ban+ti ye swāhā: zhes dang*/ oṃ a mri ta ā yur+dha de swāhā: ces pa'ang cung zad bzla ba'o// gsum pa ni/ thun de las ldang bar brtsam pa na: dbyangs gsal rten snying gis sngags kyi lhag chad kha bskang zhing brtan par bya/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus dang*/ yi ge brgya pas nongs pa bshags/ a: rig pa rang snang dam tshig pa: zhal phyag mtshan ma dbyings su thim: slar yang mkha' las 'ja' tshon ltar: ye shes chen po'i rol par shar: zhes pas slar snang 'od gsal gyi dbyings su bsdu zhing*/ zung 'jug gi skur ldang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du rgyas gdab/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag: 'chi med 'phags ma 'grub gyur nas: 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa: de yi sa la 'god par shog: ces bsngo smon dang*/ shis pa brjod pa ji ltar rigs pas mtshams sbyar te spyod lam la 'jug go /zhes lam nges rdzogs kyi dbang du byas te las dang po pa'i rnal 'byor ram/ spyir rgyun gyi nyams len 'jug pa bde ba phyag rgya gcig pa'i rnal 'byor 'di nyid/ rgyal bas lung bstan pa kun mkhyen rdo rje 'chang blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sde'i yang nas yang du bka' stsal pa dad brgya'i gtsug gi spyi bor mchod de gter gzhung rtsa ba'i dgongs pa ji lta bar mtsho skyes bla ma dgyes pa'i 'bang pad+ma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pas dpal spungs yid dga' chos 'dzin gyi gan+dho la sgrol ma dgyes pa'i nye 'dabs su bris pa'i dge bas dpal ldan bla ma dam pa zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan cing*/

mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad rje btsun 'chi med sgrol ma'i ye shes kyi sku mngon du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /'chi med 'phags ma'i snying thig gi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs tshe dbang bcud 'dzin zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rang byung rtag pa'i rdo rje tshe dpag med// 'chi bdag bdud 'joms gtsug tor rnam par rgyal// dkyil 'khor dbang phyug yid bzhin 'khor lo la// gsol ba 'debs so tshe dbang dngos grub stsol// 'gyur med ye shes rang gzugs shrī sing ha// 'pho bral 'pho ba chen po bi ma la// rdo rje'i sku brnyes pad+ma sam bha bar// gsol ba 'debs so tshe dbang dngos grub stsol// chos rgyal yab sras gdams pa'i snod ldan rje// bai ro gnubs chen mchog dbyangs nam snying 'bangs// tshe lam gsang ba'i grogs mchog mtsho rgyal mar// gsol ba 'debs so tshe dbang dngos grub stsol// 'od gsal klong nas sprul pa'i rdo rjer shar// dri med ye shes 'od brgya'i gzi brjid 'phro// 'gro ba'i mun sel dpal ldan bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so tshe dbang dngos grub stsol// mchog gyur gling pa 'chi med bstan gnyis gling*// dharmā sa rā snang mdzad rdo rje'i zhabs// rigs kun khyab bdag chos kyi blo gros la// gsol ba 'debs so tshe dbang dngos grub stsol// bai ro'i rnam 'phrul blo gros mtha' yas te// rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i gsang mdzod blo gter dbang*// rigs brgya'i khyab bdag gzhan phan snying po la// gsol ba 'debs so tshe dbang dngos grub stsol// thugs tig bka' bab gdams zab bcud 'dzin pa'i// rtsa brgyud bla ma 'chi med dkyil 'khor lha// dpa' bo ḍā ki dam can gter srung la// gsol ba 'debs so tshe dbang dngos grub stsol// yongs grub rdo rje'i bdud rtsis lus khams kyi// 'pho ba'i dri bkrus gnyug ma'i thig le gsos// ltar snang lus la brten pa'i srog gi tshe// sku yi rdo rjer 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// thabs dang shes rab thams cad bde chen ngang*// thun mong thun min gnad kyis zag pa kun// 'gyur ba med bsdams 'pho bcas thig le'i tshe// gsung gi rdo rjer 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// snang ba 'khrul med 'od gsal sbubs su tshud// rig pa dri med ka dag lhums su zhugs// nam yang mi 'gyur rtag pa gnyug ma'i tshe// thugs kyi rdo rjer 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// rgyu 'bras skye 'chi'i 'jigs pa kun las grol// 'chi med rtag pa dam pa'i tshe dbang thob// 'khor ba srid du rgyun mi 'chad pa'i sku// ye shes rdo rjer 'grub par byin gyis rlobs//

zhes pa 'di'ang de wi ko ṭi tsa 'dra rin chen brag gi snying po dpal spungs yang khrod kun bzang bde chen 'od gsal gling du pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug rtsal gyis bris pa 'chi med rdo rje'i srog thub pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
